name: axon
description: Panel de control web self-hosted para administrar un servidor completo: puertos, proyectos, Docker, dominios y más

scripts.build: bun run scripts/build-ui.ts && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun && mkdir -p dist/storage && cp src/storage/scan-host.py dist/scan-host.py && cp src/storage/trash-host.py dist/storage/trash-host.py && cp src/storage/file-task-host.py dist/storage/file-task-host.py && cp src/storage/compose-release-host.py dist/storage/compose-release-host.py && cp src/storage/installations-host.py dist/storage/installations-host.py && cp src/storage/versions-host.py dist/storage/versions-host.py && cp src/storage/edit-host.py dist/storage/edit-host.py && cp src/storage/volumes-host.py dist/storage/volumes-host.py && cp src/platform/backup-host.py dist/backup-host.py && cp src/platform/desktop-host.py dist/desktop-host.py
